messages:
Elena (Product): Quick thread: Prospect asks for a 90-day onboarding buffer with usage credits (50%), temporary throughput loosen, and a gentle overage policy. We need to decide pilot vs SKU + launch gates.

Aj (Sales): If we insist on commit they drop. We can offer a time-limited buffer but must lock a non-renewal clause. I'll get their acceptance metrics.

Sam (Pricing): Suggest ‘onramp_buffer_v1’ promo: 90d, 50% usage credit, $25k cap, one-time per legal entity, 2x short burst allowance, auto-revoke on abuse. Ops tag: promo=onramp_buffer_v1.

Dani (Legal): I will draft a 1-page addendum: mechanics, expiry, non-renewal, and right to revoke with 7-day notice. Keep it tight.

Grace (Eng): Implementation notes: per-account flag + burst pool routing + fallback to cheaper model when exhausted. Need monitoring metrics: credit_used_pct and burst_revokes. ETA 3 days for basic flag + smoke.

Olivia (RevOps): Billing: apply discount line tagged `promo:onramp_buffer_v1`. Webhook alerts at 70% and 100% credit used to AM + RevOps. Need a ledger field `promo_activation_ts`.

Elena (Product): Launch gates: legal addendum, pricing guardrails & AM signoff, billing template & alerts, eng flag/routing smoke, rollback playbook. If all green -> ship as a pilot (not an addon).

Sam (Pricing): Add revenue protection: deny repeat activations without exec approval. Log AM who enabled it.

Dani (Legal): Adding renewal prohibition and abuse language. Draft by EOD tomorrow.

Grace (Eng): Will open infra PR and include demo for QA.

Olivia (RevOps): I'll prep billing template and request a dev ticket for ledger changes.

Elena (Product): Thanks team. Please post blockers here. We'll aim to offer this pilot to the prospect after checklist complete. :thumbsup:
